about: Scheduler settings. Queue order: reader requests, top-passages.json, popular_books, then everything else (spec v0.5 §8.3). Canonical-source imports are fast, so the budget covers the whole Bible every run; the queue order drives AI-suggestion batches and the admin view. focus_books (spec v0.9 §8.8) go first of all, before reader requests; a workflow run can override them with the focus input.
